channel.title: Church of the Living God — Sunday Messages
channel.description: Sunday worship service messages from Bishop Glen Grayson and the Church of the Living God, Champaign-Urbana, Illinois. Rooted in the Word, walking in the Spirit.
channel.itunes:author: Bishop Glen Grayson

item.title: 2026-06-29 — "Walking in the Spirit" — Bishop Glen Grayson
item.description: Bishop Grayson opens the morning from Romans 8:1-4 and Galatians 5:16-25, exploring what it means to walk daily in the Spirit rather than the flesh. The message anchors in the freedom Christ purchased and the fruit that walking in the Spirit produces. Scripture references: Romans 8:1, Romans 8:4, Galatians 5:16, Galatians 5:22.

item.title: 2026-06-22 — "The Promise Keeper" — Bishop Glen Grayson
item.description: A message on God's faithfulness across generations, anchored in Hebrews 10:23 and Numbers 23:19. Bishop Grayson traces the covenant promises from Abraham through to the believer today, showing that Yahweh's word does not return void. Key text: Isaiah 55:11, Hebrews 10:23, Numbers 23:19.

item.title: 2026-06-15 — "Stewardship of Time" — Minister Poe
item.description: On redeeming the time given to us and walking in wisdom before those without faith. Grounded in Ephesians 5:15-16 and Colossians 4:5. The message draws the connection between the seven-year biblical cycle and the stewardship call on the believer today. Scripture: Ephesians 5:15, Ephesians 5:16, Colossians 4:5.

item.title: 2026-06-08 Wednesday Bible Study — "The Armor of God" — Bishop Glen Grayson
item.description: Wednesday 1pm Bible study. A verse-by-verse walk through Ephesians 6:10-18, the full armor of God. Bishop Grayson breaks down each piece of armor and its practical application for the believer facing spiritual warfare. Full text: Ephesians 6:10, Ephesians 6:11, Ephesians 6:13, Ephesians 6:17.
